Subject: Rapid-fill plan: SDR & SE offers — clearance for band exceptions

Team —

We need quick signoff to extend offers for two roles tied directly to the Nebula Analytics expansion (deal NEB-1458). Hiring team is requesting: 3 SDR ICs (remote, US) and 1 Solutions Engineer (Seattle-based). Background: Nebula requested compressed ramp (start within 3 weeks) to hit a pilot in early Dec — candidate slate is strong and TalentBridge can deliver start dates that align.

Ask: approve a one-time comp-band exception for the top SDR (15% above midpoint) and the SE (20% above midpoint) to close these fast. I attached the proposed offer matrix and the Q4 bands. Exceptions only apply to the finalists listed in TalentBridge notes (I can share resumes on request).

Key constraints:
- Compensation approval needed by EOD Wed 10/21 to issue offers that preserve start windows.
- Budget owner: Sales Ops (Marissa), will absorb partial ramp cost if approved.
- If we can't approve, TalentBridge will pull candidate holds and start dates slip to late Nov.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa: confirm budget reallocation and whether we can cover 60% of the uplift for SDRs.
2) Vivek/Karthik: agree to the exception thresholds for comp bands and sign off on job postings / req updates.
3) I will coordinate with TalentBridge and legal for offer language.

Attachments: 2026-10-offer-matrix.pdf; compensation-bands-q4-2026.xlsx

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Stephanie —

I reviewed the matrix and the Q4 budget. Short answer: we have runway to cover the exceptional uplifts for two hires if Sales Ops takes the split as you proposed. I need a formal budget transfer line (cost center + amount) before I sign off.

Can you confirm the total incremental monthly burn and the cost center so I can run it through finance? Also confirm whether these roles will be headcount-neutral for next quarter (i.e., do we need to increase the HC plan or reallocate from unfilled SDR reqs).

If you can get me that info by EOD Tues 10/20 I will approve the uplift and route to payroll/legal.

-Marissa

Thanks — quick notes from SE leadership perspective:

- SE headcount: we have one open headcount in req REQ-8347 (Greenhouse). This candidate maps directly to the Nebula pilot work and will meaningfully reduce pre-sales blocking for the account.
- I'm comfortable with 20% above midpoint for the SE if the candidate brings the required enterprise pre-sales experience (7+ years). Please attach the resume and the comp expectation line for the finalist.
- For SDRs: 15% above midpoint is acceptable for the top performer (we should not set precedent across the board). Agree on staged onboarding KPIs tied to variable compensation.

Karthik, can you confirm ramp forecasts (T30/T60) so we can quantify the productivity delta?

Vivek
Head of Solutions Engineering

Vivek/Marissa —

Ramp forecasts (conservative):
- SDRs: expected outbound productivity at T30 -> 30% of quota, T60 -> 65%
- SE: time-to-first-impact (demo/POC) estimated 5–7 weeks given existing collateral; with a dedicated SE, we increase conversion probability for NEB-1458 from ~28% to ~55% for the pilot.

Incremental monthly burn: SDR uplift (3 SDRs x avg uplift) = $18,450/month; SE uplift = $9,800/month; total incremental = $28,250/month. One-time hiring/agency fees are separate and in TalentBridge's estimate.

I recommend Marissa route $170k annual budget transfer from Q4 variable reserve to the Sales hiring pool to cover year-end prorated costs.

Karthik
Senior Director, GTM Strategy
